description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Impose Special Commodity Levy for Other Onion Rs. 10 per kg shall be Valid till April 30, 2024 Commencing from March 7, 2024
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition and waiver of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory orders made under statutory authority, specifying levy rates for specific commodities (onions) and conditions for levy waivers on rice imports. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe by name and title, this is incidental to the regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities. The content fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements under existing legislation.
